title: Model deployment launch ops playbook and presskit sync
creator: Leila Moreno
description: Objective: Coordinate a cross-functional, low-risk launch for the new model variant into the public catalog and associated channels. This ticket centralizes the operational runbook (launch day steps, rollback criteria, monitoring hooks), canonical release notes and changelog copy, the marketing press kit, and pre/ post-launch benchmark artifacts. Scope: hosted API, Dedicated customers, Private (VPC) reference notes, and the Console UX entries. Out of scope: model training/selection (handled separately) and long-term pricing strategy beyond launch guidance.
checklist: Finalize model listing metadata: short description, intended use-cases, do-not-use warnings
Attach benchmark artifacts: evaluation datasets, 95th percentile latency, token cost estimates, per-sequence throughput charts
Confirm runtime compatibility matrix with ENG: supported sequence lengths, quantization profile names, recommended batching settings
Canonicalize release notes: one-liner for console, detailed notes for docs site, and condensed blurb for email/press kit
Design review: product card mockups, screenshots for Console, and hero banner assets for the catalog page
Legal & compliance sign-off: data usage disclaimer, export controls, and model watermark guidance
Marketing press kit: short description, key capabilities bulleted, benchmark highlights, 3 canned customer quotes (placeholder), logo and banner assets
Create announcement timeline: internal-only preview (1 week prior), documentation freeze (3 days prior), public announcement (launch day @ 10 am PT)
Release notes coordination: collect PR links, GH release template, and the authoritative changelog entry
Customer comms for Dedicated/Private: migration notes if behavior changed, recommended configuration snippets, and contact path to solutions engineering
Observability hooks: add runtime-route metrics, rollout-aware dashboards, and an automated alert for regressions on quality metrics
Rollout plan: staged canary (2% production → 10% → 100%), fallback variant mapping, and timeboxed canary windows
Pricing guidance: per-token cost delta estimate and suggested default 'cost-optimized' model alias
Engineering readiness: integration tests passing, reconciliation of model artifact IDs, and infra runbook for scaling GPU pools
Launch checklist rehearsal: cross-functional dry run 48 hours before launch (PM, ENG, Design, Marketing, Support)
Post-launch: collect initial telemetry, capture top 10 support issues, and schedule a t+3 postmortem to capture lessons learned
